WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    p.SEX,
    COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) as col2
  FROM Examination e
  JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
  GROUP BY p.SEX
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT SUM(col2) as col1
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    s1.SEX as col1,
    s1.col2,
    CAST(s1.col2 AS REAL) / s2.col1 as col3
  FROM step1 s1
  CROSS JOIN step2 s2
  WHERE s2.col1 IS NOT NULL
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT AVG(col2) as col1
  FROM step3
),
step5 AS (
  SELECT 
    s3.col1,
    s3.col2,
    s3.col3,
    s3.col2 - s4.col1 as col4
  FROM step3 s3
  CROSS JOIN step4 s4
  WHERE s4.col1 IS NOT NULL
    AND s3.col2 > s4.col1
)
SELECT 
  SUM(col2) as result1,
  AVG(col3) as result2,
  AVG(col4) as result3
FROM step5
